E1321

The Output kind, payload, entry reference, callable contract, or singular selection is invalid

What

The Output kind, payload, entry reference, callable contract, or singular selection is invalid

Why

`Output` has nine closed kinds; runnable entries are checked function references. Executables take zero or one CLI-derived parameter, Services and Checks take none, and all return `()` or `!`. A singular run without `fn run` also needs one unambiguous Executable.

Fix

use a ratified kind and fields, point `entry:` at one visible safe function with the role's exact signature, or select one of the listed Executables explicitly.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1321: tests/ui/output_entry_ambiguous.stderr.

Error [E1321]: this Package has more than one runnable Executable
 Why: without `fn run`, a singular run selects only a sole compatible Output or a checked default
 Fix: choose an explicit Output or add `defaults: .{ run: one }`; candidates: one, two
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1321

Error [E0101]: this program has no `run` function
 Why: running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one
 Fix: add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0101
